runs.name: environment
runs.sql: SELECT CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductMajorVersion') AS INT) AS major, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Collation') AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS server_collation, DATABASEPROPERTYEX(DB_NAME(),'Collation') AS database_collation, @@LANGUAGE AS language

runs.name: create source
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.fmt_src(id INT CONSTRAINT fmt_src_pk PRIMARY KEY,v DECIMAL(10,2),d DATETIME2(3),f NVARCHAR(20),c NVARCHAR(10))

runs.name: create bad culture source
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.fmt_bad(id INT CONSTRAINT fmt_bad_pk PRIMARY KEY,v INT,c NVARCHAR(10))

runs.name: insert bad culture source
runs.sql: INSERT dbo.fmt_bad VALUES (1,1,N'en-US'),(2,2,N'xx-XX'),(3,3,N'de-DE')

runs.name: create not null source
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.fmt_nn(v INT NOT NULL,f NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,c NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL)

runs.name: create view
runs.sql: CREATE VIEW dbo.fmt_view WITH SCHEMABINDING AS SELECT FORMAT(v,'N') AS f FROM dbo.fmt_nn
